tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Parallel vector fields and reparametrization] 1. ch4:4-10

Let $M$ carry a connection, let $\gamma \colon I\to M$ be smooth, and let $Y\in \mathfrak X(\gamma )$. If $Y$ is parallel along $\gamma $, then its induced field is parallel along every reparametrization of $\gamma $.
